responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the AArch64 operand, register, immediate, symbolic-address, memory, and SVE-specific constraints used by reload, instruction matching, and inline asm. It gives the formal names and predicates for general-register, SIMD, predicate-register, atomic, AdvSIMD immediate, symbolic relocation, and scalable-vector immediates and addressing classes, making it the authoritative constraint vocabulary shared by the AArch64 .md patterns and user-visible extended asm.
